name: STICKEE | The Spice| 1G | Live Resin Concentrate
description: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ ". . . I hit it and immediately said ‘Winter is coming’ to my confused dog.” No, this isn’t pumpkin spice. This is The Spice—like if chai tea, cinnamon gum, and cannabis all joined a secret society. We froze the flower, stripped it down to its terpene DNA, and rebuilt it into something Sherlock Holmes would smoke before solving crimes. Nutmeg, clove, pepper—flavor notes that make you feel like Gandalf rolling a blunt. Hybrid highs don’t always hit balance like this. The Spice keeps your brain curious, your body mellow, and your tongue wondering if it just licked a bakery that also sells incense. It’s mysterious, it’s delicious, it’s the strain equivalent of that one friend who shows up with a flask and unsolicited wisdom. Buy it because life without flavor is just sad science.
